name: Background Art
description: Show a random artistic background on the chat homepage.

name: Orb Hover Glow
description: Highlight the homepage orb animation with a color glow when you hover over it.

name: Cursor Glow Trail
description: Paint a colored glow trail that follows your cursor across the chat homepage background.

name: Search Result Glow Effect
description: Add a cursor-following glow border to source cards in the search results panel.

name: TTS Voice
description: Voice used for read-aloud text-to-speech.

name: System Instructions
description: Add custom behavior or tone for the model.
placeholder: e.g., "Respond in a friendly and concise tone" or "Use British English and format answers as bullet points."

name: Follow-up Questions
description: Number of follow-up question suggestions to generate after each chat response.

name: Follow-up Questions Prompt
description: Prompt used to generate the follow-up question suggestions shown after each answer. Use {maxQuestions} for the count set above and {chat_history} for the conversation. Clear the box to restore the built-in prompt.
placeholder: Leave blank to use the built-in follow-up prompt.

name: Query Expansion Prompt
description: Prompt that rewrites your message into a standalone web-search query before sources are fetched. Keep returning the query inside a <question> block, and any URLs inside a <links> block. Clear the box to restore the built-in prompt.
placeholder: Leave blank to use the built-in query expansion prompt.

name: SearXNG URL
description: The URL of your SearXNG instance

name: Proxy URL
description: Optional HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5 proxy for outbound search and scrape requests. Format: http://user:pass@host:port or socks5://host:port

name: Tavily API Key
description: Optional. Enter your own Tavily API key to override the site default. Leave blank to use the site-provided key.

name: Scrape timeout (seconds)
description: Maximum time to wait when scraping each source URL. Slower timeouts allow more content but increase response time.

name: Show Weather Widget
description: Show the weather widget on the chat homepage.

name: Weather Locations
description: Show the homepage weather widget for one or more places. Enter one location per line as "Label, latitude, longitude" (for example: Tokyo, 35.68, 139.69). Leave blank to auto-detect your current location.

name: Weather Forecast Days
description: Number of upcoming days to show in the weather widget.

name: Weather Forecast Hours
description: Number of upcoming hours to show in the weather widget.

name: Weather Temperature Unit
description: Default temperature unit for the weather widget. You can still toggle it directly on the widget.

name: Show Trending News Widget
description: Show the trending news widget on the chat homepage.

name: Trending News API URL
description: Leave blank to use this app's built-in news endpoint (/api/news/trending). Set it to the URL of your own deployed trending-news-api Cloudflare Worker to read from that instead.

name: Trending News Topics
description: Number of trending topics to show in the trending news widget.

name: Trending News Images
description: Show article thumbnail images in the trending news widget.
